fraud_logic.rule1_amount_spike: If amount > 5x user's typical daily range → require face verification
fraud_logic.rule2_pin_failures: If pin_fail_count >= 2 (on 3rd attempt) → require face verification
fraud_logic.rule3_balance_abuse: If amount > balance AND balance_abuse_count >= 3 → HARD BLOCK, no face needed
fraud_logic.rule3_single_exceed: If amount > balance (first/second time) → block immediately (impossible tx)
